timeline: Elena arrives at the isolated lake house inherited from Aunt Cora.
Julian Vane appears suddenly from the shadows, warns her not to touch the railing; the grain of the wood seems to vibrate.
Julian explains the porch is structurally compromised and that contractors were supposed to cordon it off.
Elena mentions Aunt Cora stopped answering the phone; Julian becomes evasive and does not respond.
Elena moves to the front door; the heavy oak door swings inward with a slow creak, despite no wind.
Elena realizes the door is unlocked; Julian confirms he locked it yesterday.
Julian states that he checks the perimeter regularly and the house needs maintenance.
Elena enters the house and observes that it doesn't creak but breathes with a rhythmic expansion of timber.
Elena explores the interior, refuses to unpack, walks the perimeter, checks locks and floorboards.
Elena sees Julian outside on a ladder beneath the dining room window, wrestling with a loose shutter.
Elena grabs a heavy iron screwdriver and steps onto the porch to confront Julian.
Elena warns Julian he will split the wood; Julian responds that it is already split from rot.
Julian says he can replace the shutter next week but it needs to hold against the wind tonight.
Elena provokes Julian, asking if he is afraid of a draft; Julian says the wind looks for a way in.
Elena passes the screwdriver to Julian, their fingers briefly brushing against each other.
Julian leaves the property; his taillights disappear into the tree line.
Elena is alone in the hallway; the silence drops heavy and suffocating.
The air pressure in the vestibule shifts, pressing against Elena's eardrums.
Elena tries to calm herself, telling herself it's just an old house.
Elena approaches the front door to check the lock; the brass handle is dripping wet.
She recoils and smells the handle; the fluid smells of lake rot, algae, decay, and drowning.
The humidity in the hall spikes; the air tastes of stale lake water.
Elena closes her eyes in denial; the floorboards emit a low humming sound.
Elena flees to the parlor; the large windows look like black maws in the dark.
The sun sets completely.
